motion_and_interactions.entrance: Use framer-motion for staggered fade-up on scroll.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'DM Sans' for body text. Add them via Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement the EN/FR Language Toggle in the header as a functional-looking UI element.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-button').
Use Lucide-React for any necessary icons.
The Founder avatar MUST have the classes: ring-2 ring-[#1E3A8A] ring-offset-4 to meet the user requirement.
Do NOT use raw HTML <select> for the language toggle. Use a clean Button group or Shadcn DropdownMenu.
For the 'Future is Instant' section, apply a dark theme (bg-slate-900 or darker) to contrast with the rest of the light page, making the Cyan (#06B6D4) pop.
Ensure the hero image has a subtle blend or overlay if it risks interfering with text readability.
